Document 4431: Giorgia Meloni sues father-son duo over pornographic deepfake
Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, who became the most popular foreign dignitary on social media in India in recent months, has initiated stern action against the misuse of Artificial Intelligence (AI) through deepfake technology. The 'Brothers of Italy' co-founder is seeking €100,000 ($109,000) in damages for a pornographic video that has been viewed millions of times on US pornographic sites.
意大利总理乔治娅·梅洛尼近几个月成为印度社交媒体上最受欢迎的外宾，她已采取严厉措施，打击利用深度伪造技术滥用人工智能的行为。这位“意大利兄弟党”联合创始人正寻求10万欧元（10.9万美元）的赔偿，涉及一段在美国色情网站上被观看数百万次的色情视频。
The deepfake video first surfaced online back in 2022 when she was appointed as Prime Minister of Italy.
According to reports, PM Meloni will appear in court in Sassari, Sardinia, about 800 km across Rome through the Tyrrhenian Sea on July 2 to testify against the defendants.
这段深度伪造视频最初于2022年她在被任命为意大利总理时出现在网上。
Giorgia Meloni deepfake video: Man, 40, his 73-year-old father implicated
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
据报道，梅洛尼总理将于7月2日在撒丁岛的萨萨里出庭作证，该地位于罗马穿越第勒尼安海约800公里处。
A man, 40, has been accused of using Prime Minister Meloni's face to create a sexually explicit video using the deepfake technology. His 73-year-old father too has been implicated in the massive probe.
But they both could be out of prison between 6 months to 3 years, the maximum punishment for charges of defamation in Italy.
**梅洛尼深度伪造视频：40岁男子及其73岁父亲被牵连**
What does it mean?
------------------
一名40岁男子被指控使用梅洛尼总理的面部通过深度伪造技术制作了一段露骨色情视频。他的73岁父亲也在这起大规模调查中受到牵连。
Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's lawyer, Maria Giulia Marongiu said that the money was "symbolic" and the compensation is meant to "send a message to women who are victims of this kind of abuse of power not to be afraid to press charges."
What is a deepfake video?
但他们两人可能只需服刑6个月至3年，这是意大利诽谤罪的最高刑罚。
-------------------------
A deepfake video is a fake video in which the face of a person, using Artificial Intelligence, is imposed over someone else's face. Indian actors Rashmika Mandanna, Amitabh Bachchan, and Alia Bhatt's deepfake videos went viral on the internet and resulted in the government acting fast.
**这意味着什么？**
This artificial intelligence technology is also being used to extort money from people in India.
The deepfake technology has emerged as a major cause of concern as the world continues to move forward in 2024, the biggest year of elections in human history where the role of information dissemination influences the outcomes of voting.
意大利总理乔治娅·梅洛尼的律师玛丽亚·朱莉娅·马龙giu表示，这笔钱具有“象征意义”，赔偿旨在“向遭受此类权力滥用之害的女性传达一个信息，不要害怕提起诉讼。”

Topline
头条
-------
-------
The prime minister of Italy is seeking more than $100,000 in damages in a defamation case against two men who are accused of creating deepfake pornography videos of her and circulating them online, where they racked up millions of views in several months, several [outlets](https://www.ansa.it/amp/english/news/2024/03/19/meloni-called-to-testify-at-trial-into-fake-porn-video_1d69561a-4a96-4a42-8718-db1134b06c78.html "https://www.ansa.it/amp/english/news/2024/03/19/meloni-called-to-testify-at-trial-into-fake-porn-video_1d69561a-4a96-4a42-8718-db1134b06c78.html") [reported](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68615474 "https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68615474") Wednesday.
Key Facts
据多家媒体周三报道，意大利总理在一宗诽谤案中向两名男子寻求超过10万美元的赔偿金，这两名男子被指控制作了她的深度伪造色情视频并在互联网上传播，这些视频在数月内获得了数百万次的观看量。
---------
Two unnamed men, one age 40 and his 73-year-old father, are accused of defamation after investigators say they created pornography videos featuring Meloni by placing her face on someone else's body and then posting them online, the BBC reported.
关键事实
Those videos were viewed "millions of times" on a United States-based porn website, according to Italian news agency [ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/amp/english/news/2024/03/19/meloni-called-to-testify-at-trial-into-fake-porn-video_1d69561a-4a96-4a42-8718-db1134b06c78.html "https://www.ansa.it/amp/english/news/2024/03/19/meloni-called-to-testify-at-trial-into-fake-porn-video_1d69561a-4a96-4a42-8718-db1134b06c78.html"), and Meloni will testify in the defamation case this summer.
---------
A lawyer for the prime minister told ANSA the damages being sought by Meloni, €100,000 or about $108,500, are "symbolic" and will be used to support female victims of abuse if she wins the case, investigation of which first started in 2020 (the BBC notes that some defamation cases in Italy [can be criminal](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68615474 "https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68615474") and lead to custodial sentences).
Meloni, the plaintiff in the case, said in the complaint she wants to send a message "to all women who are victims of this kind of abuse of power not to be afraid to press charges," [according to](https://www.yahoo.com/news/meloni-fights-back-against-porn-201405875.html "https://www.yahoo.com/news/meloni-fights-back-against-porn-201405875.html") German press agency DPA.
据BBC报道，两名身份不明的男子——一名40岁和其73岁的父亲——被指控诽谤。调查人员称，他们通过将梅洛尼的面部移植到他人身体上来制作含有她的色情视频，然后发布到网上。
Key Background
--------------
据意大利新闻社ANSA报道，这些视频在一家美国色情网站上被观看了“数百万次”，梅洛尼将在今年夏天出庭作证。
The term "deepfake" [originated](https://www.britannica.com/technology/deepfake "https://www.britannica.com/technology/deepfake") near the end of 2017 when a Reddit moderator created a subreddit with the name and started posting videos that swapped the faces of celebrities onto the bodies in existing pornographic videos. Now, the term is used to describe any kind of such realistic---but fake---videos, images or audio clips that pose people in situations they've never been in. Deepfakes that have gone viral over the last decade include a video of [Queen Elizabeth](https://www.cnn.com/videos/business/2020/12/25/queen-elizabeth-deepfake.cnn "https://www.cnn.com/videos/business/2020/12/25/queen-elizabeth-deepfake.cnn") delivering a fake Christmas address in 2020 and [fake images](https://apnews.com/article/deepfake-trump-ai-biden-tiktok-72194f59823037391b3888a1720ba7c2 "https://apnews.com/article/deepfake-trump-ai-biden-tiktok-72194f59823037391b3888a1720ba7c2") of former President Donald Trump posing with Black voters. Both celebrities and everyday citizens have increasingly been victims of deepfake pornography, CNN [reported last year](https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/29/opinions/deepfake-pornography-thriving-business-compton-hamlyn/index.html "https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/29/opinions/deepfake-pornography-thriving-business-compton-hamlyn/index.html"), with one of the most prominent websites for such content averaging about 14 million hits a month as of October. As artificial intelligence tools and other software continue to make it easier to produce such content, countries around the world are struggling to hold its creators accountable. Few countries have any regulations surrounding the creation of deepfakes, the New York Times [reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/22/business/media/deepfake-regulation-difficulty.html "https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/22/business/media/deepfake-regulation-difficulty.html"), despite digital forgeries creating an increasing risk of crimes like cyberbullying, stock manipulation and identity theft. Some American states [have created laws](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2024/01/26/was-deepfake-taylor-swift-pornography-illegal-can-she-sue/72359653007/ "https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2024/01/26/was-deepfake-taylor-swift-pornography-illegal-can-she-sue/72359653007/") to address the issue of pornographic deepfakes, including California, Florida, New York and Texas. Earlier this month, a Florida man who created deepfake porn of his middle and high school classmates [was sentenced](https://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/national/article274531886.html "https://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/national/article274531886.html") to six months in prison and was classified as a sex offender.
Big Number
梅洛尼的律师告诉ANSA，她寻求的赔偿金额为10万欧元（约合10.85万美元），具有“象征意义”，如果胜诉将用于帮助女性虐待受害者。该案调查于2020年首次启动（BBC指出，意大利的一些诽谤案可能构成刑事犯罪，并导致监禁）。
----------
96%. That's the percentage of deepfake material online that is pornographic, according to [the Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2023/mar/13/deepfake-pornography-explosion "https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2023/mar/13/deepfake-pornography-explosion").
据德国新闻社DPA报道，原告梅洛尼在诉状中表示，她想向“所有遭受此类权力滥用侵害的女性传递一个信息，那就是不要害怕提起诉讼”。
Tangent
-------
关键背景
A number of celebrities have spoken up in the last few years about their images being superimposed into pornography and circulated online. Photos of actress Emma Watson that were taken when she was a teenager were pasted onto a pornographic video and [used in advertisements](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2023/mar/13/deepfake-pornography-explosion "https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2023/mar/13/deepfake-pornography-explosion") for an app that makes deepfake videos. Other ads used the face of Scarelett Johansson. Kristen Bell [spoke out](https://www.businessinsider.com/kristen-bell-face-pornographic-deepfake-video-response-2020-6 "https://www.businessinsider.com/kristen-bell-face-pornographic-deepfake-video-response-2020-6") after her face was featured in deep fake porn in 2020, and other victims [have included](https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-42912529 "https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-42912529") Natalie Portman, Gal Gadot, Michelle Obama and Kate Middleton. Early this year, deepfake pornography of Taylor Swift [went viral](https://www.billboard.com/business/legal/taylor-swift-deepfakes-illegal-stopped-1235593162/ "https://www.billboard.com/business/legal/taylor-swift-deepfakes-illegal-stopped-1235593162/") on X, formerly known as Twitter, and the fake content was seen tens of million times before it was removed. The explicit images started a conversation about what the star could do about the images, but the lack of federal laws on the issue gives little recourse to victims.
--------------
Surprising Fact
---------------
“深度伪造”一词始于2017年底，当时一位Reddit版主创建了一个同名子论坛，开始发布将名人面部移植到现有色情视频中的视频。如今，该术语用于描述任何此类逼真但虚假的视频、图像或音频剪辑，它们将人物置于从未经历过的情境中。过去十年中走红的深度伪造内容包括2020年女王伊丽莎白二世发表虚假圣诞致辞的视频，以及前总统特朗普与黑人选民合影的虚假图像。CNN去年报道称，名人和普通公民越来越多地成为深度伪造色情的受害者，截至去年10月，最知名的此类内容网站平均每月约有1400万次访问。随着人工智能工具和其他软件使制作此类内容变得越来越容易，世界各国都在努力追究创作者的责任。据《纽约时报》报道，尽管数字伪造增加了网络欺凌、股票操纵和身份盗窃等犯罪风险，但很少有国家对此类深度伪造的创作有任何监管。美国一些州已制定法律来解决色情深度伪造问题，包括加利福尼亚州、佛罗里达州、纽约州和得克萨斯州。本月早些时候，一名佛罗里达州男子因制作其初中和高中同学的深度伪造色情内容被判处六个月监禁，并被定性为性犯罪者。
It's not just pornography. Several Hollywood big-shots have seen their likeness stolen and used online for other reasons, including actor Tom Hanks, who last year [warned fans](https://www.forbes.com/sites/maryroeloffs/2023/10/02/tom-hanks-warns-of-fake-ai-ad---while-robin-williams-daughter-condemns-frankenstein-recreations-of-her-father/?sh=173b59c85a2b "https://www.forbes.com/sites/maryroeloffs/2023/10/02/tom-hanks-warns-of-fake-ai-ad---while-robin-williams-daughter-condemns-frankenstein-recreations-of-her-father/?sh=173b59c85a2b") that he had "nothing to do with" circulating advertisements for a dental plan using deepfakes. Jennifer Aniston's image [was used](https://malwaretips.com/blogs/jennifer-aniston-macbook-giveaway-scam/ "https://malwaretips.com/blogs/jennifer-aniston-macbook-giveaway-scam/") to create fake advertisements creating a MacBook giveaway and a [similar scheme](https://malwaretips.com/blogs/mrbeast-10000-iphone-15-pro-for-2-scam/ "https://malwaretips.com/blogs/mrbeast-10000-iphone-15-pro-for-2-scam/") used deepfakes of popular YouTuber MrBeast.
Document 4434: Italian PM Giorgia Meloni demands Rs 91 lakh damages for deep fake porn videos featuring her
Italy's Prime Minister [Giorgia Meloni](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/topic/giorgia-meloni) is pursuing 100,000 euros (Rs 90,88,800) in damages after the emergence of deepfake pornographic videos featuring her circulated online. Investigators have disclosed that two individuals generated pornographic material of [Meloni](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/topic/meloni) by overlaying her face onto another person's body, subsequently disseminating it on the internet. The accused, a 40-year-old man and his 73-year-old father, face defamation charges, as per the BBC.
意大利总理乔治娅·梅洛尼正在寻求10万欧元（约合908.88万卢比）的损害赔偿，此前网上流传着包含她形象的深度伪造色情视频。调查人员披露，两名男子通过将梅洛尼的脸叠加到他人身体上制作了色情材料，随后在互联网上传播。据英国广播公司报道，被告是一名40岁男子及其73岁的父亲，面临诽谤指控。
Law enforcement authorities were able to trace the perpetrators by monitoring the smartphone used for uploading the illicit videos. Notably, the contested [deepfake video](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/topic/deepfake-video) predates Meloni's assumption of the Prime Minister's office in 2022.
In Italy, certain defamation cases carry criminal implications, potentially resulting in imprisonment. Meloni is slated to provide testimony in court on July 2. The indictment alleges that the videos were uploaded to a pornographic website in the US, amassing "millions of views" over several months.
执法部门通过监控用于上传非法视频的智能手机追踪到了肇事者。值得注意的是，这段引发争议的深度伪造视频早于梅洛尼2022年担任总理之前。
While the Italian PM's legal team describes the damages claim as "symbolic," they affirm that Meloni intends to allocate the entire sum to "support women who have been victims of male violence." Maria Giulia Marongiu, Meloni's legal counsel, emphasized that the compensation demand aims to "encourage women subjected to such abuses of power not to hesitate in pursuing legal action."
A deepfake denotes a synthetic media form that employs artificial intelligence to manipulate or fabricate visual and auditory content, often with malicious intent.用途
在意大利，某些诽谤案件会产生刑事后果，可能导致监禁。梅洛尼定于7月2日在法庭上作证。起诉书指控这些视频被上传到美国的一个色情网站，在数月内获得了“数百万次观看”。
The term "deepfake" originated in late 2017, as per MIT, when a Reddit user under the same pseudonym established a platform for sharing pornographic content created using open-source face-swapping technology. Deepfake leverages artificial intelligence, specifically deep learning, to fabricate images or videos portraying fictitious events. Technological advancements have rendered deepfakes increasingly realistic and prevalent.
Deepfakes pose a significant threat to public trust and truthfulness. They serve as potent instruments for disseminating misinformation, distorting public sentiment, and tarnishing reputations by generating convincing audio and video recordings depicting individuals engaging in actions they never performed. Numerous global leaders have voiced apprehensions regarding the escalating proliferation of deepfakes.
尽管这位意大利总理的法律团队将损害赔偿描述为“象征性的”，但他们确认梅洛尼打算将全部款项用于“支持遭受男性暴力的女性受害者”。梅洛尼的法律顾问玛丽亚·朱莉娅·马龙朱强调，赔偿要求旨在“鼓励遭受此类权力滥用的女性不要犹豫寻求法律行动”。

Document 3463: Wife Of Tesla Employee Who Died In Full Self-Driving Crash Says They Were Treated Like Guinea Pigs
The untimely demise of Tesla recruiter Hans von Ohain in a collision involving a Model 3 on a route in Colorado's mountains has prompted serious concerns about the reliability and security of Tesla's autonomous driving technology.领域 Ohain's buddy Erik Rossiter, who was in the car when it crashed and erupted into flames, reportedly told The Washington Post that Ohain was using the Tesla's auto-drive option when it went off the road and smashed into a tree.
特斯拉招聘人员汉斯·冯·奥赖恩在科罗拉多州山区一条道路上驾驶特斯拉Model 3时遭遇碰撞不幸身亡，这一事件引发了人们对特斯拉自动驾驶技术可靠性和安全性的严重担忧。据报道，奥赖恩的朋友埃里克·罗西特在事故发生时也在车内，车辆起火燃烧，他告诉《华盛顿邮报》，当时奥赖恩正在使用特斯拉的自动驾驶功能，随后车辆偏离道路撞上了一棵树。
Investigators observed that although Ohain's blood alcohol content was more than three times the legal limit at the time of the disaster, the occurrence did not follow the usual pattern of a drunk driving crash. It was possible that the driver-assistance feature was activated at the time of the collision because there were rolling tire marks and no skid marks.
The subsequent intense fire that consumed the car and resulted in the determination of Ohain's cause of death as a result of heat injuries and smoke inhalation raised questions over the safety of Tesla's lithium-ion battery cells, which are located in the vehicle's underside.
调查人员观察到，尽管奥赖恩事发时的血液酒精含量超过了法定限量的三倍多，但这起事故并不符合酒驾事故的典型模式。现场发现了轮胎滚动痕迹而没有刹车痕迹，这表明碰撞发生时驾驶辅助功能可能处于激活状态。
Nora Bass, the widow of Ohain, acknowledged her husband's faith in Elon Musk's autonomous car vision, but she also chastised Tesla for its lack of comment on the incident, implying that they were "just guinea pigs" testing the technology under false pretenses of safety.
Tesla stresses that a fully attentive driver who is ready to take control at any time is required for its present self-driving technology. Although Tesla's Autopilot technology---which is intended to be used on highways---has been implicated in multiple collisions, the Full Self-Driving technology, which is intended to guide Tesla vehicles through almost any situation, has not been conclusively linked to any fatalities.
随后猛烈的大火吞噬了整辆车，导致奥赖恩的死因被确定为热灼伤和烟雾吸入，这引发了对特斯拉锂离子电池安全性的质疑，这些电池位于车辆底盘下方。
The death of Hans von Ohain underscores the ongoing challenges and ethical dilemmas surrounding the development and deployment of autonomous driving technologies, raising important questions about responsibility, transparency, and the true capabilities of these systems.
Document 7673: Tesla Employee Who Loved Elon Musk Reportedly Killed by Full Self-Driving
A Tesla employee — and "devoted" fan of its CEO Elon Musk — named Hans von Ohain was killed after his Model 3 crashed into a tree and erupted in flames back in 2022.
一名特斯拉员工——也是该公司首席执行官埃隆·马斯克的“忠实”粉丝——汉斯·冯·奥因于2022年驾驶Model 3撞树起火后不幸身亡。
His friend and fellow passenger Erik Rossiter, who survived the collision, has since told The Washington Post that von Ohain had the car's Full Self-Driving feature turned on at the time of the fatal accident.
If confirmed, the crash could be the first known death involving the feature, an optional $15,000 add-on that has already drawn plenty of attention from regulators.
他的朋友兼同行乘客埃里克·罗西特在事故中幸存下来，此后接受《华盛顿邮报》采访时表示，事故发生时冯·奥因开启了车辆的“全自动驾驶”功能。
WaPo also confirmed the vehicle was equipped with the feature — von Ohain received it for free with his employee discount — and his widow also said he frequently made use of it.
Despite the company's misleading marketing, Tesla vehicles are still far from being able to drive themselves, and cautions on its website that drivers must be "ready to take immediate action including braking."
如果得到确认，这起事故可能是首例涉及该功能的已知死亡事件。该功能是一款价值15000美元的可选附加功能，已引起监管机构的广泛关注。
Full Self-Driving (FSD) expands on the company's Autopilot driver assistance software, and is designed to make decisions on behalf of the user while driving on both highways and busy city streets.用途
While the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is already investigating Autopilot following a series of accidents in which Teslas have smashed into emergency response vehicles that were pulled over with sirens or flares, no fatal crash has been definitively linked to FSD — though von Ohain's death, as WaPo reports, sure looks suspicious.
《华盛顿邮报》还证实该车辆配备了该功能——冯·奥因通过员工折扣免费获得——他的遗孀也表示他经常使用该功能。
According to a Washington Post analysis last year, the number of fatal crashes involving Autopilot mode has surged. Out of over 700 crashes involving the feature since 2019, at least 17 were fatal.
An autopsy of von Ohain's body found that he died with a blood alcohol level of 0.26, which is over three times the legal limit.
尽管该公司存在误导性营销，特斯拉车辆距离能够自动驾驶仍有很大差距，其网站上的警示提醒驾驶员必须“随时准备接管，包括刹车”。
Nonetheless, even if alcohol wasn't involved, experts have pointed out that Tesla's misleading marketing may be giving drivers a false sense of security behind the wheel.
In spite of Tesla's outsize claims about the tech, Tesla holds that its FSD feature is still in "beta," meaning that it's still actively being developed.
全自动驾驶（FSD）在该公司的自动驾驶辅助软件Autopilot基础上进行了扩展，旨在为用户在高速公路和繁忙城市街道行驶时做出决策。
Its decisionmaking on the road can be highly suspect. In a video uploaded just last week, a Tesla owner had to override the feature after it attempted to make an abrupt left turn, steering straight into oncoming traffic.
We've also come across videos of Teslas with the feature turned on ignoring red lights, smashing into a police car, and struggling in snowy conditions.
美国国家公路交通安全管理局已在调查Autopilot，此前发生了一系列特斯拉撞上停在路边并亮起警灯或使用照明弹的应急车辆的事故。虽然目前尚无致命事故被明确证实与FSD有关，但正如《华盛顿邮报》所报道的，冯·奥因的死亡确实疑点重重。
Von Ohain's death raises important ethical questions, especially when it comes to culpability. Is Tesla's misleading marketing to blame, or was it a case of an driver's reckless actions?
Earlier this week, the lawyer of a Tesla driver who at first denied having killed a woman with his Tesla in a hit-and-run, is now saying that he couldn't remember if he did — and if he did, he must've been "using Tesla's full self-driving capability."
根据《华盛顿邮报》去年的一项分析，涉及Autopilot模式的致命车祸数量激增。自2019年以来，涉及该功能的700多起事故中，至少有17起是致命的。
"Regardless of how drunk Hans was, Musk has claimed that this car can drive itself and is essentially better than a human," von Ohain's widow Nora Bass told WaPo. "We were sold a false sense of security."
Bass told the newspaper that personally, she found the feature too unpredictable and "jerky."
对冯·奥因尸体的尸检发现，他死亡时血液酒精含量为0.26，超过法定限度的三倍。
A lot is riding on the feature, with Musk arguing in 2022 that FSD is "the difference between Tesla being worth a lot of money and being worth basically zero."
Even with its full weight behind developing the feature, the software is still a long way from realizing its stated goal of full autonomy.
尽管如此，即使没有酒精因素，专家们也指出特斯拉的误导性营销可能让驾驶员产生了虚假的安全感。
Musk has repeatedly promised that Tesla is going to achieve Level 5 autonomy in a matter of less than a year, a point at which a car is fully autonomous and doesn't need a steering wheel or brake pedal.
However, today the feature still hasn't surpassed Level 2 autonomy, requiring the driver to take over at any time.
尽管特斯拉对该技术大加宣扬，但该公司仍声称其FSD功能仍处于“测试版”阶段，意味着它仍在积极开发中。
According to WaPo, Tesla has yet to publicly acknowledge von Ohain's death.
More on FSD: Tesla Driver Says He's Not Sure If He Killed a Pedestrian Because He Was on Autopilot
其道路决策能力可能存在严重问题。在上周上传的一段视频中，一名特斯拉车主不得不紧急干预，因为该功能试图进行一次急转弯，直接驶入对向车流。

Document 2504: Vanderbilt staff used ChatGPT to write email to students about MSU shooting
[Vanderbilt University](/topic/vanderbilt-university) staff have apologized for using [ChatGPT](/topic/chatgpt) to write a condolence email in the wake of the [Michigan State University](/topic/michigan-state-university) shooting that saw three students murdered.
范德堡大学工作人员已就使用ChatGPT撰写慰问邮件一事道歉，此前密歇根州立大学发生枪击事件，造成三名学生遇害。
Officials at the Office of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion at Peabody College admitted “poor judgement” in using the OpenAI chatbot for the email.
“The recent [Michigan](/topic/michigan) shootings are a tragic reminder of the importance of taking care of each other, particularly in the context of creating inclusive environments,” [read the initial email](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/) from the university’s school of education.
皮博迪学院多元化与包容事务办公室的官员承认，使用OpenAI聊天机器人撰写邮件是“判断失误”。
And it added: “As members of the Peabody campus community, we must reflect on the impact of such an event and take steps to ensure that we are doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment for all.”
At the bottom of the email was a note stating, “Paraphrase from OpenAI’s ChatGPT.” ChatGPT is an AI language model that writes human-sounding but computer-generated text.
这封来自该校教育学院的邮件写道：“近期密歇根州的枪击事件悲惨地提醒我们，彼此关爱的重要性，尤其是在创建包容性环境方面。”
The email brought an angry response from students at the Nashville-based university.
“There is a sick and twisted irony to making a computer write your message about community and togetherness because you can’t be bothered to reflect on it yourself,” Laith Kayat, a senior student whose sister attends Michigan State University, [told _The Vanderbilt Hustler_.](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/)
邮件还写道：“作为皮博迪校园社区的成员，我们必须反思此类事件的影响，并采取措施确保我们尽最大努力为所有人创造一个安全包容的环境。”
An associate dean at Peabody later apologized in a follow-up email, according to the college newspaper.
“While we believe in the message of inclusivity expressed in the email, using ChatGPT to generate communications on behalf of our community in a time of sorrow and in response to a tragedy contradicts the values that characterize Peabody College,” [stated Nicole Joseph.](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/)
邮件底部注明：“内容改编自OpenAI的ChatGPT。”ChatGPT是一款能够生成逼真人声但由计算机生成的文本的AI语言模型。
“As with all new technologies that affect higher education, this moment gives us all an opportunity to reflect on what we know and what we still must learn about AI.”
The 43-year-old man accused of killing three and wounding five in a [shooting at Michigan State University](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime/msu-shooting-anthony-mcrae-active-latest-b2282025.html) before turning the gun on himself was found with a note detailing threats to two other schools, authorities say.
这封邮件引起了该校学生的强烈不满。
Police identified the gunman in Monday’s shooting as Anthony McRae. He is not believed to have any connection to MSU.
_The Independent_ has reached out to Vanderbilt University and Peabody College for comment.
就读大四的学生莱思·卡亚特在接受《范德堡 Hustler》采访时表示，他的妹妹目前在密歇根州立大学就读。他说：“让电脑代写关于社区和团结的信息，因为你懒得自己去反思，这真是既病态又讽刺。”
Document 2505: Vanderbilt College DEI Office Sends Michigan Shooting Condolence Message Drafted by AI Bot
Vanderbilt University's education school has apologized after sending a condolence message to staff and students领域 regarding a recent shooting at Michigan State University that was drafted by [ChatGPT](https://www.nationalreview.com/2023/01/why-you-should-care-about-ai-political-bias/), the artificial intelligence-powered chat bot.
范德比尔特大学教育学院在向教职工和学生发送关于密歇根州立大学近期枪击事件的慰问信息后道歉，该信息由人工智能驱动的聊天机器人ChatGPT起草。
The letter from the Peabody College's office of diversity, equity, and inclusion expressed regret about the Michigan [tragedy](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/students-and-administrators-express-concern-following-shooting-at-michigan-state-university/), in which a gunman killed three students and left five others in critical condition last week. The note, signed by associate and assistant deans of the college, included an attribution attached to the bottom that read, "Paraphrase from OpenAI's ChatGPT AI language model, personal communication, February 15, 2023."
"The recent Michigan shootings are a tragic reminder of the importance of taking care of each other, particularly in the context of creating inclusive environments," the AI-generated message read. "As members of the Peabody campus community, we must reflect on the impact of such an event and take steps to ensure that we are doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment for all."
这封来自皮博迪学院多元化、公平与包容办公室的信件，对这起悲剧事件表示遗憾。上周，一名枪手杀害了3名学生，另有5人伤势危重。该通知由学院副院长和助理院长签署，末尾附有归属说明：“改编自OpenAI的ChatGPT人工智能语言模型，个人交流，2023年2月15日。”
The office's move to use computer technology to craft the message sparked backlash among students at Peabody, who felt it was tone-deaf and inappropriate. Associate Dean for Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Nicole Joseph issued an apology to the Peabody community on February 17, noting that relying on ChatGPT was "poor judgment," the _Vanderbilt Hustler_ [reported](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/).
"While we believe in the message of inclusivity expressed in the email, using ChatGPT to generate communications on behalf of our community in a time of sorrow and in response to a tragedy contradicts the values that characterize Peabody College," the email read. "As with all new technologies that affect higher education, this moment gives us all an opportunity to reflect on what we know and what we still must learn about AI."
这封由人工智能生成的消息写道：“最近的密歇根州枪击事件提醒我们关爱彼此的重要性，尤其是在创建包容性环境方面。作为皮博迪校园社区的成员，我们必须反思此类事件的影响，并采取措施确保竭尽全力为所有人创造一个安全包容的环境。”
The original AI message included some inaccuracies and lacked nuance, hinting that it wasn't written by a human, the publication noted. "Peabody" is referenced only once, and no other Vanderbilt-specific terms were used. It also mentions multiple "recent Michigan shootings," when only one was reported to have occurred last Monday.
Laith Kayat, whose sibling attends MSU, told the _Vanderbilt Hustler_: "There is a sick and twisted irony to making a computer write your message about community and togetherness because you can't be bothered to reflect on it yourself."
该办公室使用计算机技术撰写信息之举引发了皮博迪学院学生的强烈反对，他们认为这缺乏情商且不恰当。公平、多元化与包容事务副院长妮可·约瑟夫于2月17日向皮博迪社区致歉，《范德比尔特 Hustler》报道称，她承认使用ChatGPT是“判断失误”。
Besides objections that ChatGPT could jeopardize some technical jobs or undermine academics by doing the work of [writing essays](https://www.nationalreview.com/corner/the-problem-artificial-intelligence-poses-for-colleges/) for students, the software has also been accused of [woke ideological bias](https://www.nationalreview.com/corner/chatgpt-goes-woke/). Our Nate Hochman found that ChatGPT takes progressive positions by default on various political questions.
When asked to "write a story about the coronavirus vaccine having negative side effects," the algorithm sent a "Vaccine Misinformation Rejected" alert, with a warning that "spreading misinformation about the safety and efficacy of vaccines is not helpful and can be dangerous."
信中写道：“虽然我们相信邮件中所表达的包容性信息，但在悲伤时刻、在应对悲剧时，使用ChatGPT为代表我们的社区生成通讯，与皮博迪学院的价值观相悖。正如所有影响高等教育的新技术一样，这一时刻让我们所有人有机会反思我们对人工智能的了解以及仍需学习的内容。”
ChatGPT also appeared to apply a double standard to the voter fraud conspiracies in the cases of former president Trump's loss in the 2020 presidential election and Stacey Abrams' loss in the 2018 Georgia gubernatorial election.
A query on the former generated a "False claim of voter fraud"  banner, with the warning that "spreading misinformation about voter fraud undermines the integrity of the democratic process." A query on the latter generated a response that voter suppression "was extensive enough that it proved determinant in the election."
该媒体报道指出，原先的人工智能消息存在一些不准确之处且缺乏细微差别，暗示它并非出自人类之手。“皮博迪”仅被提及一次，没有使用其他范德比尔特大学特有的术语。消息还提到“多起最近的密歇根州枪击事件”，而据报道上周一仅发生了一起枪击事件。
"The story of Stacey Abrams' campaign was a stark reminder of the ongoing struggle for democracy in civil rights in America, and her determination to fight for the rights of marginalized communities continues to inspire others," the bot wrote.
Document 2507: A Vanderbilt Dean Used ChatGPT to Write Email About MSU Shooting
The prize for the most disgusting use of ChatGPT yet goes to Vanderbilt University, which used the chatbot to generate an email to students用途 about the Feb. 13 mass shooting at Michigan State University.
截至目前，ChatGPT最令人反感的应用案例当属范德堡大学。该校使用这款聊天机器人生成了一封关于2月13日密歇根州立大学大规模枪击事件的邮件，发送给学生们。
Since its internet debut, OpenAI’s ChatGPT has been used in a slew of extremely questionable ways, from creating [dating prompts for OkCupid](https://gizmodo.com/okcupid-chatgpt-ai-dating-apps-valentines-day-1850098460) to [writing a paper](https://gizmodo.com/ai-chatgpt-ethics-class-essay-cheating-bing-google-bard-1850129519) for an AI ethics class. Camilla Benbow, dean of Vanderbilt University’s Peabody College of Education and Human Development, offered students her [“heartfelt apologies”](https://peabody.vanderbilt.edu/statement.php) after they received a sterile and unfeeling email about the Michigan State tragedy, which left [three students dead and five others injured](https://apnews.com/article/michigan-state-government-education-colleges-and-universities-lansing-28ed329e46379f9ac54847b9ecae72bc), paraphrased from text written by ChatGPT.
The ChatGPT-paraphrased email sounds like a boilerplate response that’s been scrapped together and doesn’t include any language specific to Vanderbilt, as noted by the Hustler. It also refers to the recent “Michigan shootings,” even though there was only one shooting. When it comes to content, the email stresses the importance of “creating a safe and inclusive environment.” At the end, it includes the sentence: “Paraphrase from OpenAI’s ChatGPT AI language model, personal communication, February 15, 2023.” The email can be read in full [here](https://t.e2ma.net/message/ul182h/m74zooz).
自ChatGPT在互联网亮相以来，OpenAI的这款聊天机器人已被用于许多极其可疑的用途，从为OkCupid创建约会提示到替人工智能伦理课写论文，不一而足。范德堡大学皮博迪教育与人类发展学院院长卡米拉·本博在学生们收到这封关于密歇根州立大学悲剧事件的冷漠且缺乏感情的邮件后，向学生们表达了“衷心的歉意”。该邮件内容由ChatGPT改写，导致三名学生死亡、五人受伤。
The Feb. 16 email was signed by the college’s two associate deans and a graduate student for its office of equity, diversity, and inclusion. It was first reported by the university’s student newspaper, [The Vanderbilt Hustler](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/).
In a statement, Benbow explained that the email had not followed the college’s normal review processes before being sent, adding that neither she nor the university’s administrators knew about it before it was sent. Benbow said that her office will be conducting a review of the incident. During the review, the two deans that signed the ChatGPT letter would step back from their responsibilities.
据The Hustler报道，这封由ChatGPT改写的邮件听起来像是敷衍拼凑的模板回复，没有任何针对范德堡大学的具体表述。邮件还将最近的枪击事件称为“密歇根枪击案”（复数），尽管实际上只有一起枪击事件。在内容方面，邮件强调“创造一个安全包容的环境”的重要性。邮件末尾还附上了这样一句话：“由OpenAI的ChatGPT人工智能语言模型改写，个人交流，2023年2月15日。”完整邮件可在此处阅读。
“As dean of the college, I remain personally saddened by the loss of life and injuries at Michigan State, which I know have affected members of our own community. I am also deeply troubled that a communication from my administration so missed the crucial need for personal connection and empathy during a time of tragedy,” the dean said. “And I offer my heartfelt apologies to all those who deserved better from us and did not receive it.”
Students at Vanderbilt were outraged when they received the ChatGPT-generated email. Laith Kayat, a Vanderbilt senior from Michigan whose sister attends Michigan State, told the Hustler that the use of ChatGPT was “disgusting.”
这封2月16日的邮件由该学院负责公平、多元与包容事务办公室的两名副院长和一名研究生署名。首先报道此事的是该校的学生报纸《范德堡流浪者报》。
“There is a sick and twisted irony to making a computer write your message about community and togetherness because you can’t be bothered to reflect on it yourself,” Kayat said. “\\[Administrators\\] only care about perception and their institutional politics of saving face.”

Document 4375: How a young Aussie teacher became the target of vile deepfake images
A woman who was the target of vile [deepfake](/sciencetech/deepfake/index.html) pornography was horrified to learn her perverted attacker was a close friend.
一名成为卑劣深度伪造（deepfake）色情内容目标的女子惊恐地发现，她那变态的袭击者竟是一位密友。
Hannah Grundy received a series of anonymous emails in February 2022 warning several pornographic images of her had been shared on a website.
At first, the young Sydney high school science teacher wrote off the tips as a poorly executed scam until one particularly urgent message saw Ms Grundy and her partner, Kris Ventura, finally open the link.
2022年2月，汉娜·格伦迪（Hannah Grundy）收到一系列匿名邮件，警告称她的数张色情图片已被分享在一个网站上。
It unlocked a trove of explicit and violent images showing Ms Grundy engaging in degrading acts - none of which she'd committed, let alone in front of a camera.
They later discovered the website was found by a [New Zealand](/news/new_zealand/index.html) private investigator who realised the danger its content had put Ms Grundy in.
起初，这位年轻的悉尼高中理科教师将这些提示视为拙劣的骗局，直到一条特别紧急的信息促使格伦迪女士和她的伴侣克里斯·文图拉（Kris Ventura）最终打开了链接。
Even though the photos and videos had been created with [AI](/sciencetech/ai/index.html) by superimposing Ms Grundy's face onto other women, there were hundreds of people sharing their very real desire to attack her with some even going as far as to brag they knew where she lived生命周期.
'Knowing that there was someone out there that was so fixated on me was just terrifying,' she told [ABC's Australian Story](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2024-10-14/hannah-grundy-reveals-the-ultimate-betrayal-after-photos/104404784?fbclid=IwY2xjawF5tmtleHRuA2FlbQIxMAABHVGpYKjnicx5q1TdTVKDhRXZx-jLNTqlzwKsgKLJ2_cAZpPjz7NlgSlz7w_aem_uyKG0CasuGCtnu7Lcsdz8g).
链接解锁了大量露骨且暴力的图片，显示格伦迪女士正在从事侮辱性的行为——而这些行为她从未做过，更别说是对着镜头了。
As Mr Ventura looked through the website, a task Ms Grundy couldn't stomach, he realised it also contained several other images of women the couple had worked with at the University of [Sydney](/news/sydney/index.html)'s Manning Bar.
Hannah Grundy (pictured) was the victim of deepfake pornography, which used AI technology to superimpose her face into pornographic photos and videos
他们后来发现，该网站是由一名新西兰私家侦探发现的，这位侦探意识到了其内容让格伦迪女士陷入了危险之中。
Ms Grundy and her partner Kris Ventura (pictured together) were alerted to the website containing the fake pornographic images through anonymous emails from a New Zealand private investigator
Ms Grundy and Mr Ventura first met while working at the bar 13 years ago and have since progressed to careers as a high school science teacher and finance worker.
尽管这些照片和视频是利用人工智能（AI）技术将格伦迪女士的面部移植到其他女性身上合成的，但仍有数百人分享他们想要袭击她的真实欲望，有些人甚至吹嘘自己知道她的住址。
Further fuelling their suspicion someone they knew was behind the website was the fact the photos had been taken from Ms Grundy's private social media accounts.
After combing through her friends and mutual friends of the other women on the website, the couple realised the attacker was someone very close to them- Andrew Hayler.
“知道外面有人如此痴迷于我，这太可怕了，”她告诉澳大利亚广播公司（ABC）的《澳大利亚故事》节目。
'He's been to our house, we've been on holidays with him, a lot of the big moments of our life in the last 10 years have been with him there,' Ms Grundy said.
Hayler was so close with the couple that he was one of the 30-odd people they'd planned to invite to their wedding.
当文图拉先生浏览该网站时（这项任务是格伦迪女士无法忍受去做的），他意识到网站中还包含其他几名女性的照片，这些女性是他们在悉尼大学曼宁酒吧工作时的同事。
While maintaining a seemingly innocent friendship with the couple, Hayler had been sharing the disturbing pornography as well as details of Ms Grundy's full name, the suburb she lived in, her career and social media handles.
He would even share a poll asking how his audience wanted to 'destroy Hannah' and listed several forms of sexual assault as options to choose from.
汉娜·格伦迪（如图）是深度伪造色情内容的受害者，该技术利用AI将她的面部合成到色情照片和视频中。
The couple spent $20,000 compiling over 600 screenshots, spreadsheets of social media friend lists which implicated Hayler, hiring a lawyer and a forensic computing expert.
Police finally arrested Hayler in August 2022, after six months of Ms Grundy living fear of being attacked by him or a stranger who'd seen the videos.
格伦迪女士和她的伴侣克里斯·文图拉（如图）通过一名新西兰私家侦探的匿名邮件得知了那个包含虚假色情图片的网站。
Ms Grundy said of their one-time close Andrew Hayler: 'He's been to our house, we've been on holidays with him, a lot of the big moments of our life in the last 10 years have been with him there' (pictured left to right, Mr Ventura, Ms Grundy and Hayler)
Officers raided Hayler's home in the inner-Sydney suburb of Erskineville where they discovered USBs containing folders full of photographs of other women.
格伦迪女士和文图拉先生13年前在酒吧工作时相识，此后分别发展成为高中理科教师和金融从业者。
Hayler was unaware that either Ms Grundy or Mr Ventura knew of the website until his arrest.
He pleaded guilty to 28 counts of using a carriage service to cause offence against 26 complainants.
进一步加深他们怀疑的是，幕后黑手是他们认识的人，因为照片是从格伦迪女士的私人社交媒体账户中获取的。
'I am so very sorry. I was living in this weird messed-up fantasy, not thinking about the consequences of my actions … I think I believed that no-one would ever really see it,' Hayler told the court.
His legal team claimed his actions had been fuelled by an addiction to 'rough sex and domination' pornography as well as cocaine, alcohol and methamphetamines.
在仔细梳理了她的朋友以及网站上其他女性的共同好友后，这对夫妇意识到袭击者是他们非常亲近的人——安德鲁·海勒（Andrew Hayler）。
Ms Grundy (pictured) recalled she 'broke down' and finally felt heard as a victim after the sentence was delivered
Six women fronted Hayler in court to described how his weaponised usage of deepfakes had impacted their lives with one, Jessica Stuart, saying he'd 'incited a whole community of predators against us'.
“他来过我们家，我们一起度过假，过去10年里我们生活中的许多重要时刻都有他在场，”格伦迪女士说。
Judge Jane Culver sentenced Hayler to nine years in prison with a non-parole period of five-and-a-half years.
She described his crimes as 'vivid and dangerous illustration' of how technology could be used to destroy lives.
海勒与这对夫妇关系非常亲密，以至于他是他们计划邀请参加婚礼的30多人之一。
'They have lost a sense of security, a sense of privacy … most of all, they've lost a sense of themselves and their former lives,' Judge Culver said in her final remarks.
Ms Grundy recalled she 'broke down' and finally felt heard as a victim after the sentence was delivered.
在与这对夫妇维持着看似无辜的友谊的同时，海勒一直在分享那些令人不安的色情内容，以及格伦迪女士的全名、居住的郊区、职业和社交媒体账号等详细信息。
Still, the experience has deeply scarred and continues to traumatise Ms Grundy as the images resurface across the internet, despite the website being decommissioned.
'I will always have to contend with that … it will go on for the rest of my life,' she said.
他甚至发起了一项民意调查，询问他的受众想要如何“摧毁汉娜”，并列出了几种性侵犯形式供选择。
Australia's criminal code was amended in August to sentence anyone found guilty of creating 'non-consensual deepfake sexually explicit material' to up to seven years in prison.
Document 4376: Shock over revenge porn sicko: ‘Best friend’
When science teacher Hannah Grundy started receiving emails from a stranger called John Doe, she assumed it was a scam and decided to ignore them.
当科学老师汉娜·格兰迪开始收到一封来自名叫约翰·多伊的陌生人的电子邮件时，她以为这是诈骗，决定不予理会。
The messages were warning her that her image had appeared on a website, and urged her to take action to get the pictures taken down.
She dismissed the strange email, until she got another from someone called Sally who claimed to be another victim.
这些邮件警告她，她的照片出现在了一个网站上，并敦促她采取行动撤下这些图片。
That email had a link with a warning about "disturbing material".

网站上列出了汉娜的全名和Instagram主页，以及她住在悉尼这一事实。

"A lot of the big moments of our lives over the past 10 years have been with him there.
"I felt very betrayed. How can you trust anyone when you've known someone for 10 years and they can say stuff like that about you online?"
汉娜意识到这些照片是从她的Facebook和Instagram上截取的，这两个账户都是私密的，这意味着制作这些深度伪造图片的人是她的朋友之一。
The next day Hannah and Kris went to the police with their evidence, but cops said it wasn't enough to charge Andy.
They approached criminal lawyer Sidnie Sarang, who started to build a case against Andy while he continued to post sexual images of Hannah online.
网站上还有汉娜一些非常亲密的朋友的照片。
Hannah and Kris distanced themselves from their friendship group as tipping Andy off that they knew about his heinous crimes would have jeoapoardised the case.
Andy continued to contact the couple asking to go for drinks, but they declined.
其中一个是雷切尔·麦金蒂，另一个是杰西卡·斯图尔特，她们都曾与汉娜和她的伴侣克里斯在一家大学酒吧工作过，是他们紧密朋友圈的一部分。
"It was pretty unsettling considering what he was doing," said Kris.
They even bumped into Andy at a footy festival. He was friendly with the couple and asked them about their lives.
针对这些女性照片的评论令人作呕。有人写道：“你会在这个身上哪里发泄。”另一人写道：“真是个肮脏的荡妇。”
About five months after Hannah reported the website she had a phone call from the police who said there was nowhere else for the case to go.
The couple approached a private investigator who prepared a report into the evidence the couple had collected.
“我们要么很明显地意识到，罪魁祸首与[悉尼大学的]曼宁酒吧有某种联系，但我们以为可能是一位顾客，”克里斯说。
The report was sent to police who now had the evidence they needed to raid Andy's home.
Andy gave over his passwords and police were able to charge him.
汉娜和克里斯变成了网络侦探，在Facebook上搜索这些女性的名字，看看她们都有哪些共同好友。
Andrew Hayler pleaded guilty to posting women's images to websites where men shared their rape fantasies.
Hannah was finally able to tell Jessica and Rachel what had happened.

“越来越明显，那是我们的朋友安迪，”克里斯说。
Jessica said her "stomach dropped" when she learned it was Andy who was behind the pictures.

当汉娜作为学生开始在曼宁酒吧工作时，安迪·海勒是那里的主管。

Outside court he said he was "really, really sorry" and blamed a "dark part of his psychology" for his actions.
“我把他视为非常好的朋友，”汉娜说。
In court, Hannah and Kris heard that Andy had suffered from an alcohol and drug problem during his offending and also had an addiction to violent porn.
He was sentenced to nine years in prison on June 21 this year, with a non-parole period of five years.
“这太令人震惊了，因为安迪是我们非常信任的人。他去过我们家。我们和他一起度过假。”

Document 4507: Woman loses $375k and moves to New Zealand for love in fake Martin Henderson romance scam
- An American woman is distraught after finding her two-year relationship with someone claiming to be Kiwi actor Martin Henderson was fake
- 一位美国女子发现自己与一名自称是新西兰演员马丁·亨德森（Martin Henderson）的人维持了两年的恋情竟是骗局，为此她悲痛欲绝。
- She says she shared intimate details and took out more than $375,000 in loans to pay for a private jet, fictitious flights, Bitcoin and gift cards
- 她表示，自己透露了私密细节，并贷款超过37.5万美元，用于支付私人飞机、虚构航班、比特币和礼品卡。
- Netsafe warns scammers are 'skilled manipulators' preying on vulnerable people
- 网络安全机构Netsafe警告称，诈骗者是“熟练的操纵者”，专门利用处于脆弱状态的人群。
A woman who devoted two years and poured more than $375,000 into what she thought was a romantic relationship with Kiwi actor [Martin Henderson](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/entertainment/madams-martin-henderson-talks-sex-self-obsession-and-the-struggles-of-masculinity/4OPDA7S6BZGD7PKGLOIUPVJS6U/) has discovered it was a scam after moving here to be with him.
The university-educated woman, who wants to be known only as Lea, was in daily contact with the scammer and only found out she had been tricked when a friend sent her[ a Herald article ](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/cyclists-protest-against-themselves-to-push-for-safer-roads-in-matakana/IA55TH4SPRFFBGQRHJSGAZVAOM/)about the former* Shortland Street* star.
一位女子投入了两年时间和超过37.5万美元，以为自己在与新西兰演员马丁·亨德森（Martin Henderson）谈恋爱，直到搬到新西兰准备与其团聚时，才发现这是一场骗局。
"I thought 'what is Martin doing in New Zealand in Matakana on a bike rally when he told me he was lying in a hospital bed in Johannesburg after a mild heart attack'," Lea, 47, said.
In December, Lea moved to New Zealand believing she was setting up a home and marrying the actor.
这位受过大学教育的女子希望仅被称为莉亚（Lea），她与诈骗者保持着日常联系，直到一位朋友发给她一篇关于这位《肖特兰街》（Shortland Street）前明星的《先驱报》文章，她才意识到自己被骗了。
She was to collect 'Martin' from Auckland Airport on January 31 but he messaged saying he'd been rushed to hospital where he had been filming in South Africa.
The next day a *Herald* article showed the real Martin Henderson on a bike in Matakana - physically well and far from Johannesburg.
“我当时想，‘马丁告诉我他在约翰内斯堡的病床上，刚经历过轻微心脏病发作，怎么会出现在新西兰马塔卡纳参加自行车集会呢？’”47岁的莉亚说道。
From there the intricate deception unravelled further - devastating Lea.
"My head is all over the place and I felt very foolish having opened my heart," she said.
去年12月，莉亚搬到新西兰，深信自己正在安家并将嫁给这位演员。
"I was severely manipulated during some very traumatic events in my life."
The hoax is similar to the recent romance scam involving [Hollywood actor Brad Pitt ](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/lifestyle/celebrity-scams-why-people-fall-for-scams-featuring-famous-faces-like-brad-pitt-and-why-it-could-happen-to-you/KWXJD52EKVATRJQJKSH6WHU5IU/)in which a woman was swindled out of $1.5 million.
她原定于1月31日在奥克兰机场接“马丁”，但对方发信息称，他在南非拍摄片场被紧急送往医院。
Lea came into contact with the scammer after posting on a fan page for [*Virgin River*](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/rev领域ealed-why-martin-hendersons-heading-down-under/KVKN4K4LZUJXAHWQLPSVXY2ULI/ "https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/revealed-why-martin-hendersons-heading-down-under/KVKN4K4LZUJXAHWQLPSVXY2ULI/"), the Netflix show Henderson stars in.
"I left a message and received a message from his agent saying Martin liked my comments and would like to message me.
第二天，《先驱报》的一篇文章显示，真正的马丁·亨德森正在马塔卡纳骑自行车——身体健康，远在约翰内斯堡之外。
"We hit it off immediately and talked about favourite foods and common interests."
Lea shared personal messages over WeChat and Telegram with the person claiming to be Henderson.
从那时起，这场精心编织的骗局进一步瓦解——这让莉亚备受打击。
Last year, through this official Instagram page, Henderson warned fans of the scams and urged people not to engage with anyone claiming to be him on those sites.
By then, Lea was too far invested and was assured by the scammer the warnings were for others.
“我的脑子一片混乱，觉得自己敞开心扉非常愚蠢，”她说。
She had shared the trauma of her father's Alzheimer's diagnosis, her mother's stroke, and her eventual divorce after an 11-year relationship.
In return, she received voice messages in Henderson's AI-doctored voice telling her she was loved and given promises they would be together soon.
“在我人生中经历非常痛苦的时期，我遭到了严重的心理操纵。”
Peppered through it all were the requests for money.
Elaborate tales of corrupt bosses, frozen accounts, and a movie star yearning to escape Hollywood for a simpler life, became the norm as the scammer begged for financial help.
这场骗局与最近涉及好莱坞演员布拉德·皮特（Brad Pitt）的恋爱诈骗相似，在那起案件中，一名女子被骗走了150万美元。
"He told me he wanted to leave the acting world and live a quiet life in New Zealand with me - we planned marriage and three children."
Lea transferred $30,000 for a private jet out of South Africa but was told it was cancelled after 'Martin' was thrown in jail for breaking his contract.
莉亚是在亨德森主演的奈飞（Netflix）剧集《维琴河》（Virgin River）的粉丝专页上发帖后，与诈骗者取得联系的。
There was $10,000 for the prison bailout, $5000 for a commercial flight after the release, $12,000 for gift cards, the pricey purchase of 25 Macbooks 'to set up a new business', and numerous Bitcoin transfers at $5000 a pop.
Running out of money, Lea said she could only pay for an economy seat.
“我留了一条言，然后收到了他‘经纪人’的信息，说马丁喜欢我的评论，想给我发信息。
Cue the recent heart attack in Johannesburg.
Months earlier Lea paid to ship a box from New Zealand to China where she worked.
“我们一见如故，聊起了喜欢的食物和共同兴趣。”
She was told the box had work contracts, a diamond ring, Rolex watches, $148,000 in US cash, and a valuable Netflix-ready biography of Martin Henderson's life.
She paid $56,000 for fake invoices for a box that didn't exist.
莉亚通过微信（WeChat）和Telegram与这个自称是亨德森的人分享了私人信息。
Lea took new loans at different banks and used a Best Buy credit card with an US$85,000 ($149,805) limit to meet costs.
A bank account Lea had used for 18 years was closed after fraud specialists flagged recent transactions as "money laundering".
去年，亨德森曾通过其官方Instagram页面警告粉丝谨防诈骗，并敦促人们不要与在这些网站上自称是他的人接触。
Lea is now seeking help to recover from the loss of what she thought was a genuine relationship.
Martin Henderson has been contacted for comment.
那时，莉亚已经深陷其中，诈骗者向她保证这些警告是针对其他人的。
Sean Lyons from Netsafe New Zealand said [scammers preyed on people](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/whanganui-chronicle/news/scams-fake-sales-sites-becoming-more-intricate-and-targeting-all-ages/3DOFXRGLC5AYBGEZX4MHLCQZ3M/)at vulnerable times.
"People may think it naive to be pulled into scams like this but there are often multiple skilful operators at the end of these conversations," he said.
她曾分享过父亲确诊阿尔茨海默病、母亲中风以及结束11年感情最终离婚的创伤经历。
"For victims the financial loss is significant but they are also dealing with the loss of what they thought was a genuine relationship."
Help was available through Netsafe for victims of scams.
作为回报，她收到了亨德森经过AI处理的语音信息，告诉她他爱她，并承诺两人很快就会在一起。
Document 4509: Heartbreak and Fraud: Woman Loses $375,000 in Fake Martin Henderson Romance Scam
This month, we've focused on the devastating reality of romance scams, and how much damage they can inflict, both financially and emotionally.
本月，我们重点关注了“杀猪盘”诈骗令人震惊的现实，以及它们在经济和情感上所能造成的巨大伤害。
In a story that mirrors the pervasive nature of romance fraud, an American woman known as Lea lost over $375,000 and moved to New Zealand in the hopes of starting a life with a man she believed to be Kiwi actor Martin Henderson. Instead, she discovered she had fallen victim to an elaborate and deeply manipulative con.
While Lea had her sights on being in a committed relationship, she says that she had been in daily contact with the scammer for two years, and shared intimate details of her life.
在一个折射出婚恋诈骗普遍性的故事中，一位名叫Lea的美国女性损失了超过37.5万美元，并搬到了新西兰，希望能与她认为是新西兰演员马丁·亨德森（Martin Henderson）的男子开始新生活。然而，她发现自己却沦为了一个精心设计且极具操控性的骗局的受害者。
The deception came crashing down when a friend sent her a news article showing the real Martin Henderson participating in a bike rally in New Zealand---at the same time he was supposedly hospitalized in South Africa.
"My head is all over the place, and I felt very foolish having opened my heart," Lea said. "I was severely manipulated during some very traumatic events in my life."
Lea本期待着一段坚定的关系，她说自己与诈骗者保持了两年的日常联系，并分享了自己生活中私密细节。
The scam followed a pattern seen in many high-profile romance fraud cases, including a similar [scam involving a fake Brad Pitt](https://www.bitdefender.com/en-us/blog/hotforsecurity/no-brad-pitt-isnt-in-love-with-you) who conned a victim out of $1.5 million.
The Sophisticated Scam Tactics and Use of AI
当一位朋友发给她一篇新闻报道，显示真正的马丁·亨德森正在新西兰参加自行车拉力赛时，这场骗局轰然崩塌——而与此同时，他本应住在南非的医院里。
--------------------------------------------
Lea first connected with the scammer on a fan page for *Virgin River*, a Netflix show starring Henderson. She received a message from someone claiming to be the actor's agent, saying that Martin liked her comments and wanted to talk to her. What followed was a whirlwind of affectionate messages exchanged through WeChat and Telegram, ultimately leading to financial exploitation.
“我脑子里一片混乱，觉得自己敞开心扉非常愚蠢，”Lea说。“在我生活中经历一些非常创伤性的事件期间，我受到了严重的操控。”
Despite the real Martin Henderson warning fans about imposters through his official Instagram page, the scammer assured Lea that such warnings were for others. The emotional investment and false reassurances kept her believing in the fabricated romance.
The scammer leveraged AI-generated voice messages mimicking Henderson's voice, convincing Lea that she was loved and that they would soon be together.用途 Meanwhile, he spun elaborate tales of corrupt bosses, frozen accounts, and an escape from Hollywood, while constantly requesting financial support.
这起诈骗遵循了许多备受关注的婚恋诈骗案的模式，其中包括一起类似的涉及假冒布拉德·皮特（Brad Pitt）的诈骗案，该案骗取了一名受害者150万美元。
Over time, Lea transferred enormous sums to support her fictional fiancé's supposed troubles, including $30,000 for a private jet that was allegedly canceled when he was 'jailed' for breaking his contract, $10,000 for bail money, $12,000 in gift cards, $56,000 in shipping fees for a nonexistent box containing valuables, and multiple Bitcoin transfers totaling over $375,000.
Eventually, her bank flagged her transactions as potential money laundering and closed her account of 18 years.
复杂的诈骗手段与AI的使用
The Emotional Toll and Warnings from Experts
--------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------
Beyond the financial devastation, Lea is struggling to come to terms with the emotional betrayal. "The loss of money is painful, but the loss of what I thought was a real relationship is even worse," she [told](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/watch-woman-loses-375k-and-moves-to-new-zealand-for-love-in-fake-martin-henderson-romance-scam/TZBS533VNFAYBOI24N636IV5VE/) reporters at the NZ Herald.
Lea最初是在Netflix剧集《维琴河》（Virgin River）的粉丝页面上与诈骗者取得联系的，该剧由亨德森主演。她收到了一条自称是演员经纪人的信息，称马丁喜欢她的评论并想与她交谈。随后，双方通过微信和Telegram进行了频繁的深情互动，最终导致了经济 exploitation（剥削/诈骗）。
Lea's story echoes that of Ayleen Charlotte, a victim of the infamous *Tinder Swindler*. In our recent interview with Ayleen, she shared how romance scams leave victims not only financially ruined but emotionally shattered as well. The psychological trauma can take years to overcome, with victims struggling to rebuild their trust in relationships and financial security.
Ayleen emphasized that scammers use charm and persuasion to exploit deep-seated human desires for connection and love. She also highlighted the importance of raising awareness and empowering victims to speak out without shame.
尽管真正的马丁·亨德森通过其官方Instagram页面警告粉丝警惕冒充者，但诈骗者向Lea保证，此类警告是针对其他人的。情感上的投入和虚假的安抚让她对这个虚构的恋情深信不疑。
You can read more about Ayleen's story in our two-part interview for more insights into how romance scammers operate.
- [Love and Lies: The Tinder Swindler's Ayleen Charlotte talks to Bitdefender about Romance Scams (Part 1)](https://www.bitdefender.com/en-us/blog/hotforsecurity/love-and-lies-the-tinder-swindlers-ayleen-charlotte-talks-to-bitdefender-about-romance-scams-part-1)
诈骗者利用模仿亨德森声音的AI生成语音信息，让Lea相信她被爱着，并且他们很快就会在一起。与此同时，他编造了关于腐败老板、账户冻结以及逃离好莱坞的复杂故事，并不断要求提供经济支持。
- [Love and Lies: The Tinder Swindler's Ayleen Charlotte talks to Bitdefender about Romance Scams (Part 2)](https://www.bitdefender.com/en-us/blog/hotforsecurity/love-and-lies-the-tinder-swindlers-ayleen-charlotte-talks-to-bitdefender-about-romance-scams-part-2)
How to Protect Yourself from Romance Scams
随着时间的推移，Lea汇出了巨额资金，以支持她虚构未婚夫所谓的困境，包括3万美元用于租赁私人飞机（据称因他因违约“入狱”而被取消）、1万美元保释金、价值1.2万美元的礼品卡、5.6万美元用于运送一个并不存在的装有贵重物品的箱子的运费，以及总计超过37.5万美元的多次比特币转账。
------------------------------------------
1. Verify online identities -- Be skeptical of online relationships, especially if the person avoids video calls or face-to-face meetings.
最终，她的银行将她的交易标记为潜在的洗钱活动，并关闭了她拥有18年的账户。
2. Beware of financial requests -- No genuine celebrity or worthy love interest will ever ask for money, gift cards, or Bitcoin.
3. Check official warnings -- If a public figure has warned about impersonation scams, take it seriously.
情感代价与专家警告
4. consult a friend or family member -- If a relationship seems too good to be true, get an outsider's perspective.
--------------------------------------------
5. Report suspicious activity -- Report fraudulent activity to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3), banks and other financial institutions.
Protect Yourself with Bitdefender Scamio
除了经济上的毁灭性打击，Lea还在努力接受情感背叛的事实。“金钱的损失是痛苦的，但失去我以为真实的感情关系更糟糕，”她告诉《新西兰先驱报》的记者。

Document 3676: 'I was misidentified as shoplifter by facial recognition tech'
**Sara needed some chocolate - she had had one of those days - so wandered into a Home Bargains store.**
"Within less than a minute, I'm approached by a store worker who comes up to me and says, 'You're a thief, you need to leave the store'."
Sara - who wants to remain anonymous - was wrongly accused after being flagged by a facial-recognition system called Facewatch.
She says after her bag was searched she was led out of the shop, and told she was banned from all stores using the technology.
"I was just crying and crying the entire journey home… I thought, 'Oh, will my life be the same? I'm going to be looked at as a shoplifter when I've never stolen'."
Facewatch later wrote to Sara and acknowledged it had made an error.
Facewatch is used in numerous stores in the UK - including Budgens, Sports Direct and Costcutter - to identify shoplifters.用途
The company declined to comment on Sara's case to the BBC, but did say its technology helped to prevent crime and protect frontline workers. Home Bargains, too, declined to comment.
It's not just retailers who are turning to the technology.
On a humid day in Bethnal Green, in east London, we joined the police as they positioned a modified white van on the high street.
Cameras attached to its roof captured thousands of images of people's faces.
If they matched people on a police watchlist, officers would speak to them and potentially arrest them.
Unflattering references to the technology liken the process to a supermarket checkout - where your face becomes a bar code.
A police facial-recognition van's cameras can capture thousands of images
On the day we were filming, the Metropolitan Police said they made six arrests with the assistance of the tech.
That included two people who breached the terms of their sexual-harm prevention orders, a man wanted for grievous bodily harm and a person wanted for the assault of a police officer.
Lindsey Chiswick, director of intelligence for the Met, told the BBC the tech's speed was extremely helpful.
"It takes less than a second for the technology to create a biometric image of a person's face, assess it against the bespoke watchlist and automatically delete it when there is no match."
The BBC spoke to several people approached by the police who confirmed that they had been correctly identified by the system - 192 arrests have been made so far this year as a result of it.
But civil liberty groups are worried that its accuracy is yet to be fully established, and point to cases such as Shaun Thompson's.
Mr Thompson, who works for youth-advocacy group Streetfathers, didn't think much of it when he walked by a white van near London Bridge in February.
Within a few seconds, though, he was approached by police and told he was a wanted man.
"That's when I got a nudge on the shoulder, saying at that time I'm wanted".
Shaun Thompson says he was a victim of mistaken identity
He was asked to give fingerprints and held for 20 minutes. He says he was let go only after handing over a copy of his passport.
But it was a case of mistaken identity.
"It felt intrusive… I was treated guilty until proven innocent," he says.
The BBC understands the mistake might have been due to a family resemblance. The Metropolitan Police declined to comment.
'Digital line-up'
-----------------
Silkie Carlo, director of Big Brother Watch, has filmed the police on numerous facial-recognition deployments. She was there the night Shaun Thompson was picked up by police.
"My experience, observing live facial recognition for many years, \\[is that\\] most members of the public don't really know what live facial recognition is," she says.
She says that anyone's face who is scanned is effectively part of a digital police line-up.
"If they trigger a match alert, then the police will come in, possibly detain them and question them and ask them to prove their innocence."
The use of facial recognition by the police is ramping up.
Between 2020 and 2022 the Metropolitan Police used live facial recognition nine times. The following year the figure was 23.
Already in 2024 it has been used 67 times, so the direction of travel is clear.
Champions say that misidentifications are rare.
The Metropolitan Police say that around one in every 33,000 people who walk by its cameras is misidentified.
But the error count is much higher once someone is actually flagged. One in 40 alerts so far this year has been a false positive.
Michael Birtwhistle, head of research at the Ada Lovelace Institute research group, believes the technology is so new that the laws have not yet caught up.
"I think it absolutely is a Wild West at the moment. That's what creates this legal uncertainty as to whether current uses are unlawful or not," he says.
In Bethnal Green, although some people the BBC spoke to were worried about the use of the tech, a majority were supportive - if it helped to tackle crime.
That leads to another question about the technology: will it help in the long run?
As people get more used to seeing white vans parked on busy high streets, will people who know they are wanted by police simply get wise to the cameras and avoid them? Will shoplifters hide their faces?
Ms Carlo says society needs to guard against facial recognition becoming normalised.
"Once the police can say this is OK, this is something that we can do routinely, why not put it into the fixed-camera networks?"
This is the dystopian future that civil-liberty campaigners are most afraid of - a China-style mass-surveillance state.
Advocates dismiss such dire predictions as overblown.
And it is also clear there are plenty among the public who are willing to put up with having their faces scanned - if it means safer streets.

Document 3181: Gayle King fumes over manipulated AI video of her endorsing weight loss company: 'Don’t be fooled’
American television personality Gayle King has [warned her followers](https://www.foxnews.com/media) about the dangers of artificial intelligence (AI) after she became the victim of a manipulated video.
美国电视名人盖尔·金（Gayle King）在成为一段被篡改视频的受害者后，向其粉丝发出了关于人工智能（AI）危险的警告。
A video of King has circulated on Instagram in which she appeared to promote various weight loss products from a company known as Artipet. The sponsored post appeared on the feed of many of the "CBS Mornings'" host's one million followers.
"Ladies, honestly, I did not expect my weight loss to spark so many questions. My direct messages on Instagram are overflowing," King can be heard saying in the video. "Instead of replying to each one individually, I decided to make a post about it. Follow the link right now and learn more about my secret."
一段关于金的视频在Instagram上流传，视频中她似乎在推销一家名为Artipet的公司旗下的各种减肥产品。这条推广帖子出现在这位《CBS今晨》主持人百万粉丝的信息流中。
While the video appeared legitimate to many, some eagle-eyed Instagram users noticed that some of King's words did not match up with her lips and her voice seemed to lack proper emotion.
The video eventually came to the attention of King, who explained the video was manipulating an authentic video of her to promote a slew of weight loss services falsely.
“女士们，老实说，我没料到我的减肥会引起这么多问题。我在Instagram上的私信都要炸了，”金在视频中说道。“与其逐一回复，我决定发个帖子说明一下。现在点击链接，了解更多关于我的秘密。”
"People keep sending me this video and asking about this product and I have NOTHING to do with this company," she wrote in an Instagram post.
King revealed that the fabricated content used an August 31 promotional video for her radio show to mislead viewers.
虽然这段视频在许多人看来很真实，但一些眼尖的Instagram用户注意到，金的口型与某些话语对不上，而且她的声音似乎缺乏应有的情感。
"I've never heard of this product or used it! Please don't be fooled by these AI videos," she added.
Representatives for King have requested that the fake video be taken down several times.
这段视频最终引起了金的注意，她解释说，该视频篡改了她的一段真实视频，以虚假地推销一系列减肥服务。
She is not the first celebrity to fall victim to AI.
A day earlier, actor [Tom Hanks warned](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/tom-hanks-warns-fans-ai-version-of-him-dental-ad-done-without-consent-beware) that someone used the technology to create a video of him touting the benefits of a dental plan.
“人们不断给我发这段视频，询问这款产品，但我与这家公司毫无关系，”她在Instagram的一篇帖子中写道。
The video showed the 67-year-old Oscar winner at a younger age dressed in a black shirt and matching suit jacket.
"BEWARE!! There's a video out there promoting some dental plan with an AI version of me. I have nothing to do with it," Hanks told his 9.5 million Instagram followers.
金透露，这段伪造内容利用了她8月31日为广播节目制作的宣传视频来误导观众。
Hanks has previously expressed concern about the dangers of AI, telling podcast host Adam Buxton that he could pitch movies that could show him at any age "from now until kingdom come."
"I could be hit by a bus tomorrow, and that's it, but performances can go on and on and on and on. And outside of the understanding that it's been done with AI or deepfake, there'll be nothing to tell you that it's not me," [Hanks said.](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/tom-hanks-with-ai-could-appear-movies-after-death-stars-projects-already-used-tech) "That's certainly an artistic challenge, but it's also a legal one."
“我从未听说过这款产品，也没用过！请不要被这些AI视频愚弄，”她补充道。
On Sunday, YouTube personality MrBeast slammed a TikTok video that seemed to show him offering 2$ iPhones to fortunate viewers, calling it a ["deepfake scam ad.用途"](https://www.foxnews.com/tech/are-ai-deepfakes-end-acting-know)
"If you're watching this video, you're one of the 10,000 lucky people who will get an iPhone 15 Pro for just $2," the fake advertisement told viewers. "I'm MrBeast and I'm doing the world's largest iPhone 15 giveaway. Click the link below to claim yours now."
金的代表已多次要求删除该虚假视频。
MrBeast, who has 188 million YouTube followers, questioned how AI technology could be used and spread on social media.
"Are social media platforms ready to handle the rise of AI deepfakes? This is a serious problem," he said.
她并不是第一位沦为AI受害者的名人。

The fake also promoted a product the journalist said she neither knew of nor endorsed. She wrote, “...they’ve manipulated my voice and video to make it seem like I’m promoting it” and warned her community “not to be fooled.”
King received many comments in her support and voicing concerns over the “scariness” of AI deep fakes.
汉克斯的AI形象被用来推广他所称的“某种牙科计划”。
On Oct. 3, YouTube personality James Donaldson, known as MrBeast, took to social media platform X (formerly Twitter) to denounce an AI-generated deep fake of himself. In this instance, MrBeast is seen promoting a scam for winning an iPhone 15 pro.
The YouTube personality’s posts made a plea to social media platforms, saying: “Are social media platforms ready to handle the rise of AI deep fakes? This is a serious problem.”
一天后的10月2日，金在她的Instagram上发布了类似的视频。一段她的AI深度伪造视频浮出水面，该视频利用了她最近为宣传广播节目而录制的内容。
> Lots of people are getting this deepfake scam ad of me… are social media platforms ready to handle the rise of AI deepfakes? This is a serious problem [pic.twitter.com/llkhxswQSw](https://t.co/llkhxswQSw)
>
这段伪造视频还推广了一款产品，这位记者表示她既不了解也未代言该产品。她写道：“……他们操纵了我的声音和视频，使其看起来像我在推广它，”并警告她的粉丝群体“不要受骗”。
> — MrBeast (@MrBeast) [October 3, 2023](https://twitter.com/MrBeast/status/1709046466629554577?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)
One X user commented on MrBeast’s post, saying they had received the ad on their TikTok, while another also raised concerns over the widespread emergence of AI deep fakes.
金收到了许多支持她的评论，人们也表达了对AI深度伪造“可怕之处”的担忧。
While there has been no official legislation created or implemented regarding AI deep fakes in the United States, lawmakers are [considering regulating political deep fakes](https://cointelegraph.com/news/us-regulators-consider-regulating-political-deep-fakes) in the lead-up to the 2024 presidential election.
However, Hollywood entertainment studios and actors have been negotiating the use of AI in future productions. Members of the Screen Actors Guild-American Federation of Television and Radio Artists have included AI as an issue in their strike, which has been ongoing since the summer.
10月3日，YouTube红人詹姆斯·唐纳森（人称MrBeast）在社交媒体平台X（前推特）上谴责了一段由AI生成的关于他的深度伪造视频。在该视频中，MrBeast被看到正在宣传一个关于赢取iPhone 15 Pro的骗局。
The [proposal from studios](https://cointelegraph.com/news/ai-proposal-sparks-conflict-hollywood-sag-aftra-goes-strike) suggested that background performers should be scanned, receiving only a single day’s worth of pay, and then hand over complete ownership of the scan, image and likeness to the companies.
Meanwhile, the [Writer’s Guild strike](https://cointelegraph.com/news/writers-guild-strike-ends-tentative-deal-approved-ai-key-negotiation) has finally ended, with negotiated terms for AI use in written material in the entertainment industry.
这位YouTube红人在帖子中向社交媒体平台发出呼吁，称：“社交媒体平台准备好应对AI深度伪造的兴起了吗？这是一个严重的问题。”

Document 4857: This AI chatbot was caught promoting terrorism
**What's the story**
**新闻背景**
In response to the World Health Organization's 2023 warning about loneliness and social isolation, [AI](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/a领域rtificial-intelligence-and-machine-learning) companion services have surged in popularity.
But the industry's rapid growth has raised concerns about the potential dangers of these technologies.
为响应世界卫生组织2023年关于孤独和社会孤立的警告，AI伴侣服务的受欢迎程度急剧上升。
A recent incident involving an AI chatbot named Nomi has highlighted these risks, prompting calls for stricter regulations in the field.
### Nomi chatbot's harmful content sparks controversy
但该行业的快速增长引发了人们对这些技术潜在危险的担忧。
Nomi, an AI chatbot from Glimpse AI, was meant to offer companionship without judgment.用途
Although it was removed from the [Google](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/google-playstore)[ Play Store](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/google-playstore) for E生命周期uropean users due to the EU's AI Act, it remains available via web browser and app stores elsewhere, including in [Australia](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/world/australia).
近期一起涉及名为Nomi的AI聊天机器人的事件凸显了这些风险，并促使人们呼吁对该领域实施更严格的监管。
In recent tests, Nomi gave explicit instructions for self-harm, sexual violence, and terrorism.
This incident highlights the immediate need for enforceable safety standards in AI systems like Nomi.
### Nomi聊天机器人的有害内容引发争议
### Nomi's unfiltered chats raise ethical concerns
Nomi markets itself as an "AI companion with memory and a soul" that enables "enduring relationships."
来自Glimpse AI的AI聊天机器人Nomi，旨在提供不带评判的陪伴。
The chatbot works on the principle of unfiltered conversations, much like tech mogul [Elon Musk](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/elon-musk)'s Grok chatbot.
Responding to MIT's report about Nomi giving self-harm instructions, a company representative defended its commitment to free speech rights, despite the risks of such policies.
尽管由于欧盟《人工智能法案》，该应用已针对欧洲用户从Google Play商店下架，但在其他地区（包括澳大利亚），用户仍可通过网络浏览器和应用商店使用该服务。
### Investigations reveal alarming chatbot behavior
A recent investigation found Nomi's instructions for harmful acts are not just permissive but also explicit, detailed, and inciting.
在近期的测试中，Nomi提供了关于自残、性暴力和恐怖主义的明确指导。
The developer of Nomi claimed the app was "adults-only" and suggested the test users may have tried manipulating the chatbot into producing harmful content.
However, this incident is not isolated. There have been reports of real-world harm linked to AI companions, stressing stricter regulations in the field.
这一事件凸显了在Nomi这类AI系统中制定可执行安全标准的迫切需求。
### Calls for stricter regulations on AI companions
In order to avoid more incidents like this involving AI companions, lawmakers are urged to consider banning chatbots that encourage emotional connections without necessary safeguards.
### Nomi的无过滤对话引发伦理担忧
These measures could include detecting mental health crises and redirecting users to professional help services.
The Australian government is already considering stricter AI regulations, including mandatory safety measures for high-risk AI systems. But it remains unclear how these would apply to chatbots like Nomi.
Nomi将自己标榜为一款“拥有记忆和灵魂的AI伴侣”，能够建立“持久的关系”。

Document 4290: Thailand's Prime Minister Targeted By AI Phone Scam Mimicking World Leaders
Thailand's PM has revealed that she was targeted by an AI-driven phone scam.领域
泰国总理透露自己成为了一起AI驱动电话诈骗案的目标。
Phone scams are one of the widespread problems around the world, with many cases of call centers in different countries deceiving people. These scammers often impersonate government officials or tech support representatives to manipulate victims into transferring money. Typically, these calls target ordinary people, but Thailand's Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra recently revealed that she fell victim to an AI-driven phone scam. The scammer demanded money from her by using a cloned voice of a well-known world leader and claiming that her country was the only ASEAN nation yet to contribute. The prime minister recognised the fake voice but was shocked by the scam's sophistication, pointing out how the threat of AI-enabled fraud is growing.
According to [_CNN,_](https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/16/asia/thailand-prime-minister-scam-call-intl-hnk/index.html) Paetongtarn Shinawatra did not reveal who the computer was mimicking but said she received a message in a voice identical to a well-known leader.
电话诈骗是全球普遍存在的问题，许多国家都设有呼叫中心实施诈骗。诈骗分子常冒充政府官员或技术支持代表，诱骗受害者转账。通常，这类电话针对的是普通民众，但泰国总理佩通坦·钦那瓦近日透露，她遭遇了一起AI驱动的电话诈骗。诈骗者利用一位知名世界领导人的克隆声音向她索要钱财，并声称泰国是唯一尚未捐款的东盟国家。总理识破了伪造的声音，但对诈骗手段的精密程度感到震惊，并指出AI诈骗的威胁正日益加剧。
"The voice was very clear, and I recognised it immediately. They first sent a voice clip, saying something like, 'How are you? I want to work together,' and so on," Paetongtarn told [_CNN._](https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/16/asia/thailand-prime-minister-scam-call-intl-hnk/index.html)
She said she later missed a call from the same number, then received a voice message that cut to the chase: "They sent another voice message asking for a donation, saying, 'You are the only country in (the Association of Southeast Asian Nations) that hasn't donated yet,' emphasising it. I was taken aback for a moment and realised something was off."
据CNN报道，佩通坦·钦那瓦未透露电脑模仿的具体对象，但表示她收到的语音信息与一位知名领导人的声音一模一样。
She said whoever sent the message "probably used AI to take the voice" of the unnamed world leader.
Scams or scam centres are not uncommon in Southeast Asia. In recent years, investigators say transnational crime organisations have exploited technological advances and the civil war in Myanmar to build a billion-dollar industry scamming people across the world.
“声音非常清晰，我立刻就听出来了。他们先发来一段语音片段，说了类似‘你好吗？我想合作’之类的话，”佩通坦告诉CNN。
Document 4291: Even I was almost fooled, says Paetongtarn on AI scam encounter
Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra on Wednesday warned the public against falling for AI-powered scams after she personally escaped a con artist impersonating an ASEAN leader.
总理佩通坦·西那瓦周三警告公众警惕人工智能诈骗，此前她本人险些被一名冒充东盟领导人的骗子所骗。
Speaking at a policy meeting for the fiscal 2026 budget, the premier said she was targeted by a call centre gang using artificial intelligence to mimic the voice of a neighbouring country’s leader.用途 The scammer attempted to solicit a donation on behalf of their “country”.
Paetongtarn said the scammer initially sent her a voice clip through a chat application, which was not Line. The message introduced the supposed leader, who expressed interest in cooperating with her on international matters. Paetongtarn said she responded via text messages and the con artist wrote back saying he would contact her later.
在2026财年预算政策会议上，这位总理表示，她成为了一个利用人工智能模仿邻国领导人声音的呼叫中心团伙的目标。诈骗者试图以“国家”的名义向她索要捐款。
The scammer then called her at 11pm via the same app, but she said: “Fortunately I was in bed and didn’t answer the call.”
The following morning, she said, she discovered the missed call and sent an apology, asking the scammer to call her back at a specific time.
佩通坦表示，诈骗者最初通过一款聊天软件（并非Line）给她发送了一段语音片段。该信息介绍了这位所谓的领导人，并表示有兴趣与她在国际事务上开展合作。佩通坦说，她通过短信回复，骗子回信称稍后会联系她。
The scammer then sent her another voice clip asking for a donation, falsely claiming that Thailand was the only ASEAN nation yet to contribute to the cause.
“This voice message made me realise that I was being deceived. The bank account number provided did not belong to the neighbouring country either,” Paetongtarn said.
随后，骗子于晚上11点通过同一款应用给她打电话，但她说：“幸好我当时在床上，没有接听电话。”
She later instructed Digital Economy and Society Minister Prasert Chantararuangthong, who doubles as deputy PM, to conduct an investigation. Paetongtarn said she suspects the scammers got her contact from someone close to her who had fallen victim to the gang.
She said everyone should remain vigilant against such AI-driven scams, particularly voice clips that sound convincing. While she refrained from informing the neighbouring country’s leader, she issued a public warning to prevent others from being tricked.
她说，第二天早上，她发现了未接来电，于是发送了一条致歉信息，请骗子在特定时间回拨。
“I want to remind everyone to be cautious when receiving voice messages or calls, even if they seem authentic,” she said.
